headline: Swedish mortgage providers raise variable rates while two banks cut fixed offers
summary: Swedish mortgage institutions collectively raised three-month variable lending rates while two major banks reduced fixed rates, narrowing the spread between variable and fixed borrowing costs for the first time in nine months.
why: Mortgage rate shifts impact Swedish household disposable income, consumer spending, and residential property prices.

impacts.name: Sweden
impacts.why: Higher variable borrowing costs increase mortgage service payments for Swedish property owners.
